storyAppearance.anatomy: Dark hands, black curls, ivory feathered wings interwoven with shafts, living gold along tendons; palm-size recollection wheel at left wing root. Gold machinery heals and remains living, not autonomous dead artefact.
storyAppearance.clothing: Ivory dress; original supports restrained gold trim/filigree.
equipment: Memory wheel at anatomical left wing root
storyAppearance.scale: Humanlike body with expansive two wings; avoid scenery-scale final gear.

explicitCanon: Distinct from Goddess of Time; no universal temporal jurisdiction inferred.
Final sheath preserves inward memory coil while outer winding teeth broken/sealed. No restoration of erased memories.
Source remains non-canon; no art name entered into universe.
visualInterpretation: Aurevra chosen solely for art under explicit user instruction to name missing identities. No historical personal name exists in current source; search universe/NAMES/story/spec records found no Aurevra reuse.
Original/cover guide adult dark brown facial structure, abundant black curls, ivory/gold flowing dress and two feathery living gold wings. Simplify ornament for clear oil anatomy.

states.name: Before sealing
states.description: Main full views, small toothed recollection wheel at left wing root beneath low feathers.

states.name: Sealed
states.description: Small separate shoulder/wing-root detail shows smooth living gold sheath; no exposed outer drive teeth.

characters.lighting: Source opening false dawn reflects rose on ivory feathers and muted copper on shafts; broad rose morning-facing masses with quiet mauve brown shadows, subordinate local warmth from living veins.

characters.name: Sovekh
characters.role: Adult ceremonial singer who secretly rewound the Seraph's memory and is finally returned to ground.

selectionEvidence.quote: A broad man, grown well into adulthood, with a singer's lifted chest and an embroidered collar that had chafed his neck raw.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Explicit build, adulthood, posture and clothing.

storyAppearance.anatomy: Broad adult man, singer's lifted chest, mild raw chafe at neck; no magical powers.
storyAppearance.clothing: Embroidered collar, sleeve stained with apricot syrup, one shoe fastening lost.
equipment: Plain short bronze bar, tool used on gears
storyAppearance.scale: Ordinary human proportions; not a priest/warrior with magic.

explicitCanon: Distinct identity from Sovet in Leave the Names; no shared appearance or supernatural power.
Source does not specify skin/hair/precise age; selected appearance is art interpretation.
visualInterpretation: Broad stocky man in his forties, warm olive skin, receding short dark brown curls and close full beard, deep-set hazel eyes, soft square jaw. Ochre tunic with muted red/gold embroidered collar, brown trousers and worn low leather shoes.

states.name: False dawn
states.description: Cold tired singer, chafed collar, stained cuff and one loose shoe fastening.

characters.lighting: Same early false dawn as Seraph: restrained rose-facing planes and cool brown-mauve shadow; not ignition's brief all-white flash.
